Kept the canonical kitchen workflow clusters and did not add an island as a required element because the brief prioritizes open center circulation in a compact room.

Compact 14.2m2 kitchen with very high center-openness bias favors perimeter-only core and conservative optional retention.
Island and dining are not realistically useful under the stated clear-center priority unless surplus is unusually high; keep them droppable early.
Storage support is useful but secondary; prefer one tall/pantry element only when wall capacity remains after core placement.
